evidence.explanation: Only AKLYS occurs in the monster autoreturn table; no AKLYS artifact exists in the pinned catalog. Thus the artifact_hit condition cannot hold for supported catalog objects on this call path. Ordinary return fumble deals two HP with the chosen draws. Catalog intersection empty. Aklys fumble consumes rn2(5), rn2(100), rn2(2), rnd(3), reduces HP 30 to 28, puts weapon on floor, and never records artifact_hit as unported. Scope: A catalog/caller proof at these revisions, not blanket suppression of artifact_hit gaps. Invalidate when arwep, artifact catalog or the caller gate changes. A manually assigned artifact flag on an aklys is not a valid counterexample. No C gameplay recording claimed.

evidence.explanation: Ready Vrock sets mspec_used to 75+rn2(25), creates gas size 5/damage 8, then enters fleeing state. Existing cooldown suppresses cloud and cooldown draw. Default delegate creates one damage-8 five-cell region, mspec_used=75, mfleetim=5. Draw bounds [25,4,3,2,1,2,4,3,2,1,3]. Cooldown=1 control creates no region and consumes no draws. Scope: The local property-call/closure delegation hides the direct edge from the scanner. Presence of this owner does not prove complete cloud parity: sibling vrock-gas-call-prompt-vision confirms a downstream prompt/display divergence. Independent C recording in that sibling proves public-input reachability and prefix parity.
